nodes.label: OWGT Wordmark (robot mascot over O-W-G-T lockup)
nodes.rationale: Square raster logo on white, roughly 1236px, drawn as a friendly mascot: a thick black rounded-rect robot head with side ear pods, a top antenna and ball tip, one solid round black eye, one arc-shaped winking eye, and a curved smile. Beneath it, 'O W G T' in heavy condensed blue capitals separated by black dots. Mark and wordmark are stacked on one axis, and the generous white border on all sides makes the file safe to drop straight into a header or hero without cropping.

nodes.label: Robot Mascot Mark (winking robot head)
nodes.rationale: A thick black outline rounded-rect head with ear pods, a ball-tipped antenna, one round eye, one winking arc and a smile. The wink is what makes the mark friendly rather than technical, and the robot motif is a direct visual pun on the organisation's STEM/robotics subject matter.

nodes.label: Brand Blue Accent Palette
nodes.rationale: The only saturated brand colour in the whole asset set: a medium bright blue reserved for the O W G T letterforms, paired with near-black for the mascot and the interpunct dots. Restricting blue to the wordmark keeps it identifiable as the accent rather than a background colour.

nodes.label: OWGT Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: The combined system of mascot + wordmark + blue accent. Treats the name as a single lockup that must always travel together, so the mark is never shown without the O W G T letters and the letters are never set in another typeface or colour.

nodes.label: Logo Asset Duplication (two copies of one wordmark)
nodes.rationale: placeholder/public/owgt-logo.png and assets/images/owgt-logo.png are the same brand mark in two files at two resolutions and two crops, with the placeholder carrying far less white margin. Because both paths are plausible for a reference to resolve to, the brand can render at two different optical sizes depending on which one is picked up. Recommended fix: one canonical logo file, one path, and let CSS handle padding.
